# octopusdeploy_approval_policy (Resource)

This resource manages approval policies in Octopus Deploy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of this resource.

### Optional

- `allow_self_approval` (Boolean) Whether the deployment creator may approve their own deployment.
- `approving_team_ids` (List of String) A list of team IDs that are eligible to approve deployments under this policy.
- `approving_user_ids` (List of String) A list of user IDs that are eligible to approve deployments under this policy.
- `description` (String) The description of this approval policy.
- `id_scopes` (Attributes List) A list of ID-based scopes this approval policy applies to. Used when `scoping_strategy` is `"Id"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--id_scopes))
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is disabled.
- `minimum_approvers_required` (Number) The minimum number of approvers required for this approval policy.
- `scoping_strategy` (String) The scoping strategy used by this approval policy. Valid values are `"Tag"` or `"Id"`.
- `space_id` (String) The space ID associated with this approval policy.
- `tag_scopes` (Attributes List) A list of tag-based scopes this approval policy applies to. Used when `scoping_strategy` is `"Tag"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_scopes))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID for this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--id_scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `id_scopes`

Required:

- `project_id` (String) The project ID for this scope.

Optional:

- `environment_ids` (List of String) A list of environment IDs for this scope.


<a id="nestedatt--tag_scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag_scopes`

Optional:

- `environment_tags` (Set of String) A set of environment tags for this scope, specified as tag IDs (e.g. `TagSets-1/Tags-1`) or canonical tag names (e.g. `TagSet/Tag`). Canonical names are resolved to their tag IDs, which are what gets stored in state.
- `project_tags` (Set of String) A set of project tags for this scope, specified as tag IDs (e.g. `TagSets-1/Tags-1`) or canonical tag names (e.g. `TagSet/Tag`). Canonical names are resolved to their tag IDs, which are what gets stored in state.
